liveNote: L3 (not run this round, per round policy: unit+integration only): to decide F-PREDELETE-LIVENESS, run a live cluster: enable a preDelete hook, delete the RI (not the Pods), and observe whether member-Pod containers receive SIGTERM while the preDelete marker is still set — kubelet starts graceful termination on deletionTimestamp regardless of the Pod's finalizer; GC deletes dependents once the owner has a deletionTimestamp. Expected signal if the design gap is real: container termination begins during the preDelete wait, bounded by terminationGracePeriodSeconds.
